review.reviewNotes: The draft is well-structured and accurately captures the syllabus for transition elements (d-block). Concepts, mathematical formulas, and chemical equations are correctly written and well-explained. The worked examples have rigorous step-by-step logic, and the self-check questions align perfectly with the core principles. Clarification of concepts like LMCT vs. d-d transitions and anomalous electronic configurations is a great inclusion.
